description: Use whenever a change touches the Core layer of a Dotkernel project — adding or editing a Doctrine entity, repository, enum, DBAL type, fixture, migration or shared service — or when deciding whether code belongs in Core versus an application module. Also use for git submodule mechanics (.gitmodules, git submodule add/init/update, committing from inside src/Core) and for questions about sharing code between Dotkernel projects on one database.
